Class CommandHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.view.tui.input.CommandHandler
public class CommandHandler extends Object
Handles the execution of commands received from the CommandParser. This class translates user input commands into actions performed on the ClientModel and sends requests to the VirtualServer.

    void
    setNotified()
    Sets the `notified` field to `true` and starts a new thread that resets it to `false` after a delay of 100 milliseconds.
    This method is used to notify the handler if an exception has been reported; if this is not the case, a message of confirmation of correct input can be shown to the user.

    • setNotified

      public void setNotified()
      Sets the `notified` field to `true` and starts a new thread that resets it to `false` after a delay of 100 milliseconds.
      This method is used to notify the handler if an exception has been reported; if this is not the case, a message of confirmation of correct input can be shown to the user.
